title: Smoked Duck Teriyaki
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring smoky roasted duck in a sweet teriyaki sauce.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
Heat the sesame oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast until browned, about 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast the duck for 12-15 minutes or until cooked to your liking.
While the duck is cooking, combine soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a small saucepan.
Bring the sauce to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove the duck from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the duck into thin slices and serve with the teriyaki sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
